heldout_split.method: sha256(source) low bit; every function from one source stays together

frame_order.rule_selected_by_train_pairwise: loop refs desc, static refs desc

word-scalar.train_chosen_rule: loop refs desc, static refs desc

register_allocation.interpretation: Winner ranking is scored with the observed number of S_REGISTER records per function held fixed (oracle capacity); this isolates local priority from the still-unmodeled decision to allocate and how many registers are used.
register_allocation.source_visible_candidate_rule: 2-byte word scalar or near pointer, not volatile and not address-taken; this covers 203/205 S_REGISTER records. The two exceptions are far-pointer/aggregate CodeView type cases.

dataset.source_group_split: sha256(source) low bit; whole source held together
